description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Travel Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN looking for flexibility, with both full-time and part-time options available, offering a highly competitive salary.

In this vital role, you will provide comprehensive skilled nursing care to patients in their homes, developing and implementing individualized care plans. You will play a crucial part in patient education, symptom management, and ensuring continuity of care, collaborating closely with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal patient outcomes.

This position offers the chance to make a significant impact on patients' lives while enjoying the autonomy and diverse experiences that come with home health travel nursing.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana or a compact state.
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent experience in home health or acute care setting.
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and documentation skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $125,000 annually, based on experience and contract type (Full-time or Part-time).
